boundaries.coverage: webLogin/nativeLogin pages only; capture spans attachment through ordinary context close and can include tail; budgets use only the unchanged two windows; no cold FIRST capture; initial Native document may precede attachment
boundaries.identity: per-document UUID and timeOrigin; CDP loader IDs are separate local identities, not a guessed cross-layer join
boundaries.delivery: asynchronous test binding; missing delivery, other schema values and overflow remain incomplete; failure/pending counters sum observations and can repeat at snapshot/seal
boundaries.clocks: product monotonicMs is relative to its actual document timeOrigin; wallMs and CDP monotonic clocks are separate
boundaries.cost: retained rows/bytes are bounded; per-event CPU/IPC delivery is not capped and occurs inside original windows; no production performance claim
boundaries.unknownAssociation: no user, workspace, raw SWR key, URL query, headers, body or server invocation ID; ambiguous action/time joins remain unknown

originalWindowAudit.scope: all actual pg.Client.query calls and PostgreSQL protocol bytes in the primary API process; no sampling
originalWindowAudit.background: all concurrent primary API background traffic is included; no guessed subtraction or per-request attribution
originalWindowAudit.boundary: query calls started and protocol bytes transferred by each checkpoint; in-flight response bytes can cross a checkpoint
exclusions: test-account lease/session tracking and fixture SQL in the separate harness process
PostgreSQL connection handshake and TCP/TLS overhead
originalWindowAudit.diagnosticBoundary: SQL calls belong to (before.queryCalls, after.queryCalls]; completion times never choose a SQL window. IDs show ALS origin, including inherited background work; a captured null action is never backfilled. Structure equality proves neither equal parameters nor redundant work.

limitations: No shared ID joins product requests, CDP requests and server SQL invocations.
SQL invocation indices and occurrence numbers cover query-bearing invocations only; original physical/logical RPC totals remain separate.
Product object IDs require page/document/producer namespace; ID zero is omission. CDP IDs have a separate page-local namespace.
React mount and SWR focus are not directly instrumented; no observed Live chain means unknown, never proof of mount/focus.
A key/action/shape match does not prove identical arguments, owner, workspace or redundant work.
Original query membership is ordinal-based, never changed by this timestamp index; setup and tail events remain present.
Sidecar gaps, omissions, drops and late attachment prevent negative causal conclusions.
Wall and document/CDP clocks are retained separately, without tolerance, clock correction or inferred document navigation IDs.
Live associations expose observed source-order/key/after candidates; overlapping/coalesced triggers retain ambiguity.
This diagnostic has CPU/IPC cost and cannot establish the formal final SQL budget PASS.
